description: This file defines a custom exception class `ProjectServiceException` within the `OrangeHRM	ime	ype` namespace, used for handling specific errors related to project activities in the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

classes.name: ProjectServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for project service-related errors, providing specific static methods to generate exceptions with predefined messages.

methods.name: projectActivityExist
methods.description: Returns a new `ProjectServiceException` indicating that project activities with logged time cannot be deleted.

methods.name: duplicateProjectActivityNameFound
methods.description: Returns a new `ProjectServiceException` indicating a duplicate project activity name was found.

methods.name: projectActivityNotFound
methods.description: Returns a new `ProjectServiceException` indicating that a project activity could not be located.
